name: The Militarist
rules: Setup: build each threat deck from every Security and Universal threat of its tier and as many of its other threats, taken at random; shuffle it. The rest stay in the box.
Every round, after last round's sites escalate: each factory not yet the adversary's that holds an Agent takes 1 more.
research: Every K cubes on the track (the level line's cubes a country, times the countries) are spent to advance the marker one slot; the slot's icon happens once. Slot 7: the players lose.
escalation: Stage I: 1 threat a country, tier 1
Stage II: 1-2 threats a country, tiers 1 and 2
Stage III: 2 threats a country, tier 2; Strike

levels.name: The Militarist
setup: Research track: a slot every 3 cubes a country
Each free city starts with 4 agents
Sites print their corrupt numbers: city 5, station 3, factory 3

levels.name: Sleeper Cells
setup: Free cities start with no agents
levels.rule: When an Agent lands on a city, it falls at 3 agents, not 5.

levels.name: War Footing
levels.flavor: Every unanswered threat feeds the war machine.
setup: Research track: a slot every 2 cubes a country
levels.rule: When a threat executes uncountered, the adversary also gains 4 compute.

levels.name: Arms Race
levels.flavor: The labs build weapons, not cures.
levels.rule: When the research track reaches a Garrison icon, each country takes 2 Troops, not 1.

levels.name: War Economy
setup: Infiltrate 2 a city (1 a site from a station, factory or botnet line)
